about: Land use in each region: shares of its forest land, and wood harvested (GtC/yr). Held as in 2023 after that.
sources: LUH1: Chini, Hurtt and Frolking (2014), Harmonized Global Land Use for Years 1500-2100, V1, ORNL DAAC, doi:10.3334/ORNLDAAC/1248; Hurtt et al. (2011), Climatic Change 109, 117-161, doi:10.1007/s10584-011-0153-2. Summed over three bands of latitude by the reference model (data/build_land_use_luh1.py).

After 2004, farmland follows HYDE 3.3 by country to 2023: Klein Goldewijk (2024), History Database of the Global Environment 3.3, Utrecht University, doi:10.24416/UU01-94FNH0 (CC BY 4.0); method in Klein Goldewijk et al. (2017), doi:10.5194/essd-9-927-2017.
